title: Garlic Smashed Red Potatoes

items.body: Make the garlic butter. Melt the butter in the skillet over medium heat. When the foam subsides, add the rosemary and the minced garlic. Cook until fragrant, ≈30 s. Take it off the heat and set it aside for step 4.

ings.name: Garlic
ings.note: peeled, left whole, for the pot

items.body: Boil the potatoes. Put the potatoes, the 2 whole garlic cloves, the salt and the bay leaf all in the saucepan together. Add cold water until everything is covered by 1 in. The garlic boils with the potatoes, which makes it soft and mild. Bring to a boil, then lower to a gentle simmer. Cook until a paring knife slides into a potato with no resistance, 35–45 min (check early; baby reds cook faster).

Drain. Scoop out ½ cup of the cooking water and save it. Drain the pot in a colander. Throw away the bay leaf. Pick out the 2 boiled garlic cloves and save them for step 4. Put the potatoes back in the empty pot and let them stand uncovered until their surfaces look dry, ≈5 min.

Make the sauce while the potatoes dry. In the mixing bowl, mash the 2 boiled garlic cloves with a fork. Add the garlic butter from step 1 and the cream cheese, and whisk until smooth. Whisk in ¼ cup of the saved cooking water, the salt and the pepper.

Smash and serve. In the pot, smash the potatoes with a spoon just enough to break the skins. Fold in the sauce until it’s mostly absorbed, leaving some chunks. Add more of the saved cooking water, 1 tbsp at a time, until they’re slightly looser than you want; they thicken as they stand. Taste, add salt and pepper if needed, and serve.

nutritionSource: USDA FoodData Central: SR Legacy (red potatoes with skin, unsalted butter, garlic) and Branded Foods labels (Philadelphia, Morton). Salt in the cooking water mostly drains away and isn’t counted; neither are rosemary, bay leaf or pepper.
notes: The garlic is used two ways: 1 minced clove goes in the butter (step 1), and 2 whole cloves boil with the potatoes (step 2). Both end up in the sauce. Want more garlic? Boil extra whole cloves.
Keep the potatoes about the same size so they finish together. Morton amounts match the weight of ATK’s table salt.
